RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL   ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the March 17, 2006/Phalguna 26, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests; Food Processing Industries;
Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
Damage to Kirandul-Visakhapatnam
rail track due to overloading
*341. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY:  Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the 472
kilometers long rail track from Kirandul to
Visakhapatnam is in danger of heavy
damage due to overloading of iron ores in
goods trains;
(b) whether some trains were recently
cancelled due to damage to the tracks;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) the amount lost due to such
cancellation;
(e) the reasons for not taking prompt
action;
(f) whether the geologists have also
expressed fear about this track;
(g) if so, Government’s response
thereto; and
(h) the steps being taken by
Government to improve the situation?
Threat from Atmospheric Brown
Cloud
*342. DR. NARAYAN SINGH
MANAKLAO:  Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Atmospheric Brown Cloud (ABC), a
terminology generally used for the
enormous blanket of pollution comprising
ash, acids, etc., reduces the chances of
monsoon rains substantially in the
subcontinent thereby causing potential
threat to the agricultural harvests;
(b) if so, the measures taken/proposed
to be taken by Government to tackle the
threat;
(c) whether any study to assess its
impact on our country has been carried
out;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?

107
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Quality of fruits and vegetables
supplied through Mother
Dairy outlets
*343. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
DR. VIJAY MALLYA:
 Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the quality of vegetables
and fruits particularly onions and potatoes
supplied through the Mother Dairy outlets
in Delhi is inferior;
(b) whether any check is exercised by
the senior officers of his Ministry on the
officials of the organization responsible for
procurement;
(c) if so, at what level and whether any
irregularities/corruption in the procurement
have come to the light; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the action
taken to ensure reasonable good quality of
vegetables and fruits at reasonable prices
are made available through Mother Dairy
outlets in the State?
Leprosy patients in the country
†*344. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 62 per cent
of the world’s leprosy patients are in our
country;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
largest number of such patients are there in
Bihar, Uttar Pradesh Orissa, Madhya
Pradesh and West Bengal;
(c) whether there is no qualitative
change in its present status despite the
leprosy eradication programme of
Government; and
(d) if so, the details of the existing
number of Leprosy patients and their
condition, State-wise and the details of
action taken by Government in this regard?
Venture capital fund for dairy and
poultry industry
*345. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
 Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have launched
a new NABARD-sponsored venture capital
fund for dairy and poultry industry with
corpus of Rs. 25 crores for three years;
(b) if so, whether Government would
ensure that provision of its micro-credit to
individual entrepreneurs, unemployed
youths, etc. percolates  to tribals and other
deprived sections of the society for their
gainful employment; and
(c) whether the backward and tribal
districts of Chhattisgarh and Yavatmal in
Maharashtra would be identified for
selective operaton of this scheme for the
year 2007, through NGOs or cooperative
societies functioning in such districts?
Assistance to Madhya Pradesh for
fishery development
†*346. SHRI LAXMINARAYAN
SHARMA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to refer to
answer to Unstarred Question1056 given
in the Rajya Sabha on the 2nd December,
2005 and state:
(a) whether the Government of
Madhya Pradesh has made a proposal
for sanctioning Rs. 52.49 lakhs for

108
development of fishery in reservoirs under
construction and constructed under the
Narmada Valley Development Project; and
(b) if so, by when the said amount would
be provided to the State?
Gauge conversion in north-eastern
region

Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased
to state:
(a) the names of rail lines that are under
conversion from metre gauge to broad gauge;
(b) the names of metre gauge lines that
are not under such conversion;
(c) whether in the north-eastern region
rail lines are mostly in metre-gauge and due
to this reason the goods are subjected to
frequent loading a

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the March 17, 2006/Phalguna 26, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests; Food Processing Industries;
Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 155
Crop diversification project of
Maharashtra
2401. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Government of Maharashtra has submitted
a proposal for crop diversification project
for the State;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action Government propose to
take in this regard?
Modified crop insurance project of
Maharashtra
2402. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Government of Maharashtra has submitted
modified crop insurance scheme for the
State and requested for its accord;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when the necessary sanction will
be given?
Kisan Call Centres
2403. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Kisan Call Centres have
been set up in Uttaranchal to assist the
farmers; and
(b) if so, the number of such KCCs
opened in various districts of the hilly and
backward State of Uttaranchal so far along-
with the details of their functions?
Advance planning for increasing
agricultural production
2404. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Government
have directed State Governments to prepare
advance planning to increase production in
agriculture sector especially in growing
potatoes and onions during 2006-07; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?

541
Aid to Consultative Group on
International Research
†2405. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the annual
amount of 2.5 million dollars given to the
Consultative Group on International
Agricultural Research by Government, so
far, has been increased to the amount of 10
million dollars;
(b) if not, the details thereof;
(c) whether the said institution has
benefited the Indian agriculture sector
during the last five years;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the contribution of these benefits in
increasing agricultural production in the
country?
New breeds of cows
†2406. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
 DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that new breeds
of cows have been developed by
undertaking research in various universities
of the country;
(b) the names of institutions that have
developed these cows during 2002 — 2005
alongwith the names of their breeds;
(c) whether Government have
formulated any national level scheme for
encouraging the commercial production
from these cows; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Rule for fixing MSP of wheat
†2407. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the criteria for fixing Minimum
Support Price of wheat;
(b) the rent per acre of land fixed for
Minimum Support Price of wheat and the
expenses supposed to be incurred on diesel,
manure, water, seeds, labour etc., for per
acre of land;
(c) the basis on which these figures have
been fixed;
(d) the steps being taken by
Government for providing actual price to
the farmers for their crops; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Decrease in use of pesticides
†2408. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that with the
increase in cultivation of biotech crops the
dependence on the use of pesticides has
come down;
(b) whether it has benefited the
cultivators of BT cotton a lot; and
(c) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto?
Small and marginal farmers
†2409. SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the percentage increase or decrease
in the number of marginal farmers and small
farmers as per the census of 1990-91 and
2000-2001;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

(b) the areas of land being cultivated by
them as per the latest census, State-wise;
(c) whether Government have initiated
steps to enhance income of marginal and
small farmers by attracting them towards
the occupation of dairy, fishery and poultry
farming from the cultivation; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Indian Ocean Tuna Commission

Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:

Ocean Tuna Commission has offered
diverse facilities for Indian fishing sector;
(b) whether it is also a fact that a
delegation of officials is visiting the
Commission to confirm and ensure that
India gets share of tuna resources in the
Indian Ocean;
